nodes.Name: traceAllocFreeTypesBatch
nodes.DocComment: Batch type values for the alloc/free experiment.

nodes.Name: traceAllocFreeInfoBatch
nodes.DocComment: Batch type values for the alloc/free experiment.

nodes.Name: traceSnapshotMemory
nodes.DocComment:
traceSnapshotMemory takes a snapshot of all runtime memory that there are events for
(heap spans, heap objects, goroutine stacks, etc.) and writes out events for them.

The world must be stopped and tracing must be enabled when this function is called.

nodes.Name: SpanExists
nodes.DocComment: SpanExists records an event indicating that the span exists.

nodes.Name: SpanAlloc
nodes.DocComment: SpanAlloc records an event indicating that the span has just been allocated.

nodes.Name: SpanFree
nodes.DocComment: SpanFree records an event indicating that the span is about to be freed.

nodes.Name: traceSpanID
nodes.DocComment: traceSpanID creates a trace ID for the span s for the trace.

nodes.Name: HeapObjectExists
nodes.DocComment:
HeapObjectExists records that an object already exists at addr with the provided type.
The type is optional, and the size of the slot occupied the object is inferred from the
span containing it.

nodes.Name: HeapObjectAlloc
nodes.DocComment:
HeapObjectAlloc records that an object was newly allocated at addr with the provided type.
The type is optional, and the size of the slot occupied the object is inferred from the
span containing it.

nodes.Name: HeapObjectFree
nodes.DocComment: HeapObjectFree records that an object at addr is about to be freed.

nodes.Name: traceHeapObjectID
nodes.DocComment: traceHeapObjectID creates a trace ID for a heap object at address addr.

nodes.Name: GoroutineStackExists
nodes.DocComment: GoroutineStackExists records that a goroutine stack already exists at address base with the provided size.

nodes.Name: GoroutineStackAlloc
nodes.DocComment: GoroutineStackAlloc records that a goroutine stack was newly allocated at address base with the provided size..

nodes.Name: GoroutineStackFree
nodes.DocComment: GoroutineStackFree records that a goroutine stack at address base is about to be freed.

nodes.Name: traceGoroutineStackID
nodes.DocComment: traceGoroutineStackID creates a trace ID for the goroutine stack from its base address.

nodes.Name: traceCompressStackSize
nodes.DocComment: traceCompressStackSize assumes size is a power of 2 and returns log2(size).
